steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製邀請碼 u7nDfG，再開啟 App Store 的光南好站頁面。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies invite code u7nDfG, then opens the 光南好站 page on the App Store.

steps.zh-TW: 下載並開啟光南好站 App；Android 版請用下方來源的 Google Play 連結。
steps.en: Download and open the 光南好站 app; on Android, use the Google Play link under sources below.

steps.zh-TW: 依畫面指示註冊，在要求邀請碼的地方貼上 u7nDfG，或依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入；欄位位置本站未確認。
steps.en: Register as directed; paste u7nDfG where an invite code is requested, or type it as shown (case-sensitive). This site has not confirmed where the field is.

steps.zh-TW: 回饋內容與領取方式以光南官方公告為準；分享文案沒有說明具體回饋。
steps.en: Rewards and how to claim them follow the official announcements; the share text states no concrete reward.

intro.zh-TW: 光南大批發的會員 App（App Store 名稱：光南好站）：下載後依指示輸入邀請碼 u7nDfG。
intro.en: Member app of the 光南大批發 chain (App Store name: 光南好站): after download, enter invite code u7nDfG.

description.zh-TW:
光南大批發是台灣的連鎖折扣零售通路，會員 App 在 App Store 名為光南好站。

本站的連結不含邀請碼，也不是個人連結：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製邀請碼 u7nDfG，再開啟 App Store 的光南好站頁面。分享文案沒有說明具體回饋，本頁不列出優惠；實際內容以光南官方公告為準。
description.en:
光南大批發 is a discount retail chain in Taiwan, and its member app is named 光南好站 on the App Store.

The link on this page is not a personal link and does not carry the invite code: selecting “Sign up” first copies code u7nDfG, then opens the App Store listing. The share text states no concrete reward, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the chain’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案只有 App 商店連結，沒有個人連結，所以「立即註冊」開啟的是 iOS 的 App Store 頁面；Android 版見來源的 Google Play 連結（頁面未能讀取，套件名稱與 iOS 版相同）。邀請碼不在連結中，請在 App 內貼上或依原樣輸入。邀請碼名稱取自分享文案，App 內用語與輸入畫面本站未確認，也未測試是否被接受。itunes.apple.com 是 Apple 的共用網域，列入後該網域的連結都能通過本站檢查；光南官網頁尾與 App Store 隱私權條款標題有同一公司名稱（笑笑笑國際股份有限公司），證據是間接的。App Store 年齡分級 4+，官網未找到會員條款。維運者沒有開啟分享文案的商店連結；日期依 2026-10-24 讀取的 App Store 頁面。
notes.en: The share text only gave app store links and no personal link, so “Sign up” opens the iOS App Store page; for Android see the Google Play link under sources (the page could not be read, but its package name matches the iOS app). The code is not in the link, so paste or type it in the app exactly as shown. The code name comes from the share text; the in-app wording and entry screen were not confirmed, and acceptance was not tested. itunes.apple.com is Apple’s shared host, and listing it lets any link on that host pass this site’s checks; the official website footer and the title of the privacy policy linked from the App Store listing show the same company name (笑笑笑國際股份有限公司), which is indirect evidence. The App Store age rating is 4+, and no membership terms were found on the official website. The maintainer did not open the store links in the share text; the date rests on reading the App Store listing on 2026-10-24.

q.zh-TW: 光南大批發的邀請碼 u7nDfG 要怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use the 光南大批發 invite code u7nDfG?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼是 u7nDfG，區分大小寫。本站的連結不含邀請碼，點擊「立即註冊」會先複製它，再開啟 App Store 頁面；下載並開啟 App 後，依畫面指示貼上或手動輸入。本站未註冊，邀請碼是否被接受未經測試。
a.en: The invite code is u7nDfG and is case-sensitive. The link on this page does not carry it: selecting “Sign up” copies the code first, then opens the App Store page. After installing and opening the app, paste it or type it as the screens direct. This site has not registered, so acceptance was not tested.

q.zh-TW: 使用光南大批發邀請碼有什麼回饋？
q.en: What reward does the 光南大批發 invite code give?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只寫「和我一起推薦好友拿好禮」，沒有說明具體回饋與由誰領取，本站也沒有在光南官網找到邀請碼的說明，所以不列出優惠。實際內容以光南官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text only invites you to recommend friends together with the sender to get gifts. It states no concrete reward or who receives it, and no explanation of the invite code was found on the official website, so no offer is listed. Actual terms follow the official announcements.
